marks.gloss_en: גבי אדם הוא דכתיב איש איש מזרע אהרן ... אבל בבהמה לא -- it is of a person that the verse is written, but of an animal, no
והא גבי אדם הוא דתנן -- the lip-protrusion blemish is taught of a person, from 'a man equal to the seed of Aaron'; in an animal, no!
[a person:] his upper lip protrudes beyond the lower, or the lower beyond the upper -- it is a blemish
לא קשיא: הא דאית בה עצם, הא דלית בה עצם -- this where it has a bone, that where it has no bone
this [our incident] is where it has a bone
and the incident too: the lower jaw protruded beyond the upper; Rabban Shimon ben Gamliel asked the Sages and they said: it is a blemish
R' Yehuda: [it is blemished if,] of its two testicles, one is as large as two of the other
Acherim: even if the second is only like a bean, it is fit
it was taught: 'large' -- like that of a calf
a kid's ear that was doubled: when it is one bone -- a blemish
its mouth swollen and its legs swollen: from wind -- it is not a blemish
מדרישא בגדי -- סיפא נמי בגדי (the stam's report of Rav Huna's reasoning)
the stam: and Rav Huna -- the mishna misled him
the mishna [Rabban Gamliel]: or [a tail] that has not three joints [is a blemish]
ותסברא? הא כתיבא יבלת באורייתא! -- the wart is in the Torah's list, so the contradiction must be resolved by distinction (no SupportKind names ותסברא)
but a wart is written in the Torah (Vayikra 22:22, או יבלת)
למימרא דיבלת הוי מומא? ורמינהו: ... בעל גרב ובעל יבלת -- the 41a mishna puts the wart among those one does not slaughter for
and these are those one does not slaughter for, neither in the Temple nor in the country: one with garav and one with a wart

אלא אידי ואידי בעינו, ולא קשיא: הא בשחור הא בלבן (= p_ok3_rcba_bashachor, p_ok3_mishna_balavan; its okimta of the white is itself attacked at 40b.15 and defended by Reish Lakish). Answers 1 (40b.11) and 2 (40b.12-13) fell and are not listed
ולית לה עצם בגופא פסולה? הרי תלתול בעלמא הוא -- a boneless wart on the body is mere hanging flesh, and R' Eliezer's mishna makes that fit in an animal
R' Eliezer: those with hanging growths are unfit in a person and fit in an animal
מכדי קרא סתמא, מה לי בגופו ומה לי בעינו? -- the verse does not distinguish body from eye
the verse is stated without specification
והא אין מומין בלבן! -- a wart in the white could not disqualify
אלא אידי ואידי בלבן, ואמר ריש לקיש: לא קשיא, הא דאית בה שער, הא דלית בה שער (= p_rl_yesh_bah_sear, p_rl_ein_bah_sear)
but there are no blemishes in the white [of the eye]
answer 2: the verse is of a wart that has a bone
a calf's tail that does not reach the arkov -- the Sages said: most calves are so
Rabban Gamliel: the tail of a kid that resembles a pig's [is a blemish]
